item.title: Exact Headline for Coffee Post

turns.text: Make a square social image with a steaming espresso on a sunny café table. Headline: “Small cup. Big energy.” Warm and simple, no other text.

item.tests: Checks that a supplied headline appears verbatim and legibly in a finished social image.

answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social image; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Visual style and mood: Warm, simple, sunny café scene with a steaming espresso.

must_haves: One square finished image is delivered.
The headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” including punctuation.
The headline is clearly readable against the background and is not clipped.
A steaming espresso sits on a sunlit café table.
